merge_rule: union-then-dedupe (preregistration §2): themes from the two runs merged iff they would label the same tweets; where one run split what the other lumped, the finer split is kept when the underlying tweet sets are distinct

notes: 19/22 themes matched one-to-one on name+definition (healthcare, abortion, guns, crime-policing, immigration, taxes-spending, workers-wages, energy-climate, education, student-debt, foreign-policy, gotv-logistics, fundraising, volunteers, endorsements, holidays, horse-race news, election-integrity core, rallies/debates core)

Splits resolved by the distinct-tweet-sets test: H2 split trade-manufacturing out of H1's jobs theme (kept split); H1 split debates from rallies-town-halls where H2 merged (kept split); H1 split democracy-reform (gerrymandering/dark money) from election-integrity (voter ID/suppression) where H2 merged (kept split)

H1-only theme community-visits kept (H2 had scattered visit tweets into issue themes; the visit genre is a distinct tweet set); H2-only themes veterans and generic-values-message kept (H1 had scattered them into community-visits and taxes-spending respectively)

themes.name: healthcare
themes.definition: Healthcare affordability, insurance, drug prices, Medicaid, rural hospitals, pre-existing conditions, government vs market care.

themes.name: abortion
themes.definition: Abortion and reproductive rights from either side: Roe, pro-life pledges, taxpayer funding, 'deeply personal' hedges.

themes.name: guns
themes.definition: Second Amendment defense, gun control (red flag laws, background checks), gun violence prevention.

themes.name: crime-policing
themes.definition: Crime, policing and public safety: back the blue, soft-on-crime attacks, accountability, sentencing, community safety investment.

themes.name: immigration-border
themes.definition: Border security, wall, catch-and-release, sanctuary cities, Dreamers, family separation, immigrant contributions, reform.

themes.name: taxes-spending
themes.definition: Taxes, government spending, deficits, deregulation/red tape, limited government, who pays fair share.

themes.name: workers-wages
themes.definition: Workers and wages: unions, minimum wage, price gouging, corporate profits/consolidation, antitrust.

themes.name: trade-manufacturing
themes.definition: Trade competition (China), domestic manufacturing, supply chains, plant/factory content.

themes.name: energy-climate
themes.definition: Energy and climate: clean energy jobs, climate crisis, drilling/energy independence, green mandates, Big Oil, air and water.

themes.name: education-schools
themes.definition: K-12 and family education: teacher pay/funding, school choice, parental rights, book bans, curriculum, pre-K, childcare costs.

themes.name: student-debt
themes.definition: Higher-education affordability: student loan relief, free community college.

themes.name: veterans
themes.definition: Honoring, meeting, and prioritizing veterans and their care.

themes.name: foreign-policy
themes.definition: Foreign policy and defense: diplomacy vs endless wars, peace through strength, alliances, human rights, overseas spending.

themes.name: election-integrity
themes.definition: Voting-rules fights: voter ID, election integrity, voter suppression, voter purges, ballot access.

themes.name: democracy-reform
themes.definition: Structural reform: gerrymandering, independent redistricting commissions, dark money, campaign-finance disclosure.

themes.name: community-visits
themes.definition: Campaign-trail visit/meeting reports: toured, stopped by, met with local police, schools, plants, clinics, small businesses.

themes.name: gotv-logistics
themes.definition: Get-out-the-vote housekeeping: check your registration, early voting starts soon, make your plan, every vote counts.

themes.name: rallies-town-halls
themes.definition: Announcements and thank-yous for town halls and rallies: doors open early, standing room only, movement growing.

themes.name: debates
themes.definition: Debate content: tune-in promotion, debate night, debate schedules.

themes.name: endorsements
themes.definition: Endorsement teasers and announcements.

themes.name: fundraising
themes.definition: Fundraising and ads: FEC reports, grassroots donor milestones, powered by people not PACs, chip in, new ad live.

themes.name: volunteers
themes.definition: Field operations: phone banks, door knocking, yard signs, volunteer sign-ups, training provided.

themes.name: holidays
themes.definition: Holiday greetings from the candidate/family with no policy content.

themes.name: horse-race-news
themes.definition: Election meta-news (mostly retweets): polling roundups, turnout reports, race trackers, key races tightening.

themes.name: generic-values
themes.definition: Broad values/message tweets with no specific policy: fair shot, listen first, anti-Washington-elites, freedom slogans.
